tasks.gr12-source-based-and-essay-skills-t4: Topic: Source-based and essay skills. Cover source provenance, purpose, audience, usefulness and reliability, corroboration, recognising bias, interpreting cartoons and visuals, planning essays with a clear argument, using chronology accurately, and supporting claims with evidence. Ask Grade 12 learners to practise exam technique.
tasks.gr12-resistance-and-apartheid-crisis-rev: Topic: Resistance and apartheid crisis revision. Revise Black Consciousness, Soweto 1976, trade unions, the UDF, COSATU, tricameral reforms, states of emergency, sanctions, and how internal and external pressure produced the crisis of apartheid. Ask Grade 12 learners to compare causes, methods, and significance across topics.
tasks.gr12-democracy-and-cold-war-revision-t4: Topic: Democracy and Cold War revision. Revise independence in the Congo and Tanzania, the end of the Cold War, de Klerk's reforms, negotiations, political violence, the 1994 election, and the TRC. Ask Grade 12 learners to explain turning points, compare African case studies, and link global change to South Africa's transition.
